control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity
integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - change request not applied to SG-4100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 2 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on SG-4100 and TX-3002 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. SG-4100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 10 March 2012 a planned field verification of SG-4100 and TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the earth leakage and protection setting integrity not effective.
